author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Hello, today is the 1st of July and my question is: where is Atlas or its release date? You've promised to finish it until July. 
Can you tell us real deadline? It can be September or next year, never mind. Just don't make same mistakes.
And don't tell me about maps converting. 
125 maps / 10 map devs = 12,5 days (one map per day).

title: Atlas, where are you?

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body: There is no confirmed date for Atlas' release. Also, I believe it was delayed for quite a bit because of the map conversions and I can assure you that it wouldn't only take 12.5 days to finish all of the maps.
